user.title: Connect to Alertas Chile
user.description: This integration subscribes to the public Alertas Chile relay (CSN, Sismo Detector, SENAPRED SAE, and tsunami bulletins). No account or credentials are needed. The relay will be tested before setup completes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Alertas Chile relay. Check your connection and try again.

init.title: Alertas Chile options
init.description: Choose which alert sources create entities. Disabled sources are still received by the relay; only their entities are omitted.

error.no_sources: Select at least one alert source.

confirm.title: Retry the relay connection
confirm.description: The relay at {url} has failed several reconnects in a row. Confirm to reload the entry and retry.
